assessments.reasoning: §9.1.2.1 steps 1–4 return the unresolvable Reference Record at null and otherwise call the current record's HasBinding. A true result returns a Reference Record with that environment as [[Base]]. A false result recurs on [[OuterEnv]], preserving name and strict.

challenge.method: Traced two matching environments, an inner miss followed by an outer match, exhaustion at null and an abrupt HasBinding. Compared §9.4.2 ResolveBinding and §6.2.5.5 GetValue steps 2 and 4.
challenge.results: The first true ends the search even if an outer record would also match. Each false advances one link. Null produces a record with an unresolvable base, and an abrupt binding check is propagated. GetValue separately enforces the unresolvable read error or calls GetBindingValue on a resolved environment.

limitations: The result describes reference selection. A selected binding can have additional conditions on when its value may be read.
